name: gather_spec_extras
description: Gathers speculative-decoding rows selected by integer indices from three pool buffers and optionally a hidden-state pool. Returns (topk_p, topk_index, output_tokens, hidden_states), each newly allocated; hidden_states is None when hidden_states_buf is None. Shapes: indices [M], topk_p_buf [P,topk], topk_index_buf [P,topk], output_tokens_buf [P], hidden_states_buf [P,hidden] or None. Current tests exercise M 1..2048, topk 8, hidden 4096/7168 and the no-hidden mode; inputs are read-only.
